title: Pager page data and extra payload accessors

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerGetData exposes the mutable page image for a referenced page, while sqlite3PagerGetExtra exposes the cache-owned per-page extra payload.

external_source_responsibilities: Pager/page-cache acquisition establishes a live reference before data access
Page cache allocates data and extra slices with Pager-selected widths
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete accessors are assigned; B-tree opening consumes pageData on a live page-1 reference and Pager trace observes both exact slice identities.

inputs: Mutable cache Page; pageData requires a positive live reference
outputs: Borrowed mutable page data slice or borrowed mutable extra slice
contracts.ownership: Returned slices alias cache-owned storage and never transfer ownership.
contracts.state_and_results: pageData asserts positive reference count and returns the exact Page.data slice. pageExtra returns the exact Page.extra slice without mutation.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns Pager/cache synchronization; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Typed non-null pages only; debug assertion rejects unreferenced pageData use.

representation_differences: Zig returns length-carrying mutable slices rather than untyped void pointers.
The source permits memDb data access without a positive reference; the runtime cache owner always uses live references at production call sites.

oracle.protocol: Acquire page 1 through a live Pager, require pageData to preserve the SQLite header bytes and require pageExtra pointer identity with the page-cache extra slice before release.
oracle.normalization: Within-process slice pointer identity and bytes compare exactly; absolute addresses are not cross-engine observations.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller synchronization and page lifetime external.
assurance.malformed_input: Typed non-null page and debug reference assertion.
assurance.continuation: Pure borrowed observations leave page ownership unchanged.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig page accessors and src/core/btree.zig database opening
integration.native_call_path: B-tree database opening acquires page 1 and reads its header through pageData; Pager/cache owners expose extra payload through pageExtra.

independent_review.notes: Requires broader caller conversion, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Convert remaining direct B-tree page data and extra uses where source ownership boundaries require it.
Add pinned-C page data/extra identity and lifetime differential.

callers: B-tree page-1 header initialization and page parsers

callees: Direct Page.data and Page.extra cache-owned slices
